spec_match.rationale: All four policies now use the shipped SanitizerConfig shape (elements with {name, attributes:[...]} entries, replaceWithChildrenElements, global attributes:[] + dataAttributes, comments) verified against wicg.github.io/sanitizer-api and CfT 153: new Sanitizer(config) succeeds for every policy and sanitizer.get() normalised output is shown.

interactive.rationale: Each policy produces distinct native output on CfT 153: comment keeps b,i,a (wrappers unwrapped); rich keeps h2,p,ul,li,b,i,a; strict keeps only a[href] (javascript: href dropped); plain-text keeps no elements but keeps wrapper text.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card copy now describes each config exactly, including that unlisted elements are removed with their content (plain text is explicitly not textContent).

edge_cases.rationale: Constructor errors are surfaced under the policy label (verified by injecting the old attributes-dict shape: status shows the real TypeError, output left empty, no default fallback). Rich demonstrates the dataAttributes-needs-global-attributes rule. Sample textarea now closes its <script>, so 'Click bait' renders.

references.rationale: Adds the spec SanitizerConfig link alongside chromestatus and MDN.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 7/7 PASS on CfT 153, but it only constructs Sanitizer({elements:['p']}) and never checks the attributes shape or that a custom config changes output — so it did not catch this page's fake fallback.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Node Playwright on a local server :3113 (NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, unavailable here; Playwright ariaSnapshot used for the a11y tree). Before: comment/rich/strict serialized output identical (default sanitizer); Enter on a card did nothing; textarea swallowed 'Click bait'. After: four distinct outputs, Enter (rich) and Space (strict) select cards with aria-pressed updated, 0px overflow at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800, 0 console/page errors (only the console.warn from the deliberate bad-config injection).

telemetry_health.rationale: Constructor failures are no longer swallowed: shown in a role=status line and console.warn'd; not reported as console.error, so shared telemetry may not count them.

design_system.rationale: Variables and readable contrast in screenshots.

accessibility.rationale: Cards are native <button aria-pressed> in role=group 'Sanitizer policy' (ariaSnapshot: button ... [pressed]); visible focus-visible outline; policy result announced through a polite role=status line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; cards and Apply button min-height 44px.

openQuestions.title: Show sanitizer.get() normalisation and allow/remove mutators
openQuestions.detail: The spec exposes get(), allowElement/removeElement/replaceElementWithChildren/allowAttribute/removeAttribute/setComments/setDataAttributes/removeUnsafe; an inspector that edits a Sanitizer and prints get() covers the configuration-tooling angle.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML with setHTML Sanitizer config
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use setHTML() with a Sanitizer config of the current shape (elements, attributes, replaceWithChildrenElements); elements not in `elements` are removed together with their content; list wrappers whose text you want in replaceWithChildrenElements; custom configs can only restrict the safe default.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — all four configs rewritten to the current shape; plain-text policy uses replaceWithChildrenElements to keep text, copy states unlisted elements lose their content.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible single-select card group radio keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native <button> over div+role; native elements need no Enter/Space handlers; expose toggle state with aria-pressed; announce changing results via a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — div cards replaced with native <button aria-pressed> in a labelled group (no custom key handlers); status line is role=status aria-live=polite.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer textContent over innerHTML for text; use setHTML() for untrusted HTML; never interpolate untrusted strings into innerHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — config, status and serialized output written with textContent; constructor errors rendered as text, never as default setHTML output.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.

summary: Goal-setting fix 2026-11-08: the three policies that threw (stale attributes-dict shape) and silently fell back to the default sanitizer now use the shipped SanitizerConfig shape and produce distinct, correct output; constructor errors are shown under the policy label; cards are keyboard-operable buttons with aria-pressed; the sample's <script> now closes. Remaining: the config-inspector concept (get() + mutators) is still unbuilt.
